If you’ve had past conflicts with Kate, this could be an opportunity to extend grace rather than reacting in anger or judgment. 2. **Wisdom in Conflict (Proverbs 15:1, James 3:17)** - Reacting harshly (e.g., complaining loudly, leaving abruptly) may escalate tension rather than resolve it.
